author: TOI TECH DESK
description: In October, consumers can expect a rise in prices for popular appliances such as air-conditioners and washing machines. Manufacturers attribute this increase to the escalating costs of materials and freight, compounded by ongoing supply chain challenges. Brands like Blue Star and Godrej Appliances are raising their prices by 5 to 8 percent. However, some retailers still have older inventory available at unchanged prices, particularly as the festive shopping season begins.
title: TVs, washing machines, ACs & other consumer electronic prices may go up this Oct

author: LISA MONTEIRO
description: The Bombay high court expressed concern over the Election Commission's SIR process after several names were removed. Justices Valmiki Menezes and Amit Jamsandekar questioned the legality of the actions taken during the SIR. They highlighted the suspension of several laws under the Representation of People Act and related rules. A family from Santa Cruz brought the matter to the court's attention following their removal from the electoral rolls.
title: ‘You’re giving a go by to rules, acts ... doing your own thing’: Bombay HC to EC

author: SHIVANGHI PAYAL
description: At the G20 trade ministers' meeting in Milwaukee, US trade representative Jamieson Greer discussed key trade issues with Indian minister Piyush Goyal. They focused on food security, steel overcapacity, and the Most-Favoured-Nation principle, which Greer suggested re-examining. Goyal emphasized the importance of distinguishing between legitimate measures and the weaponization of food supply chains. Discussions also included efforts toward finalizing an interim India-US Bilateral Trade Agreement, enhancing cooperation in manufacturing.
title: Piyush Goyal gets a ‘trade minister for life’ tag from US trade chief at G20

author: TOI REAL ESTATE DESK
description: A rare 2-acre private island estate on Minnesota’s Lake Minnetonka has hit the market for $7.25 million after 53 years with one family. Gale Island features 1,841 feet of lakeshore, multiple historic homes and cabins, a waterfront gazebo, tower and log cabin, offering a unique multigenerational retreat near Excelsior and Wayzata.
title: 53-year family island on Lake Minnetonka listed for $7.25M

author: TOI ENTERTAINMENT DESK
description: Vishal Chaturvedi's film 'Hanuman Ansh' recorded an India net collection of Rs 2.35 cr on its 55th day. The film's total India net earnings now stand at Rs 314.63 cr, showcasing strong box-office performance. Significant fluctuations in weekly collections were observed, particularly increases in the fourth and fifth weeks. The film's cumulative overseas gross collection reached Rs 39.10 cr, contributing to worldwide earnings of Rs 410.75 cr.
title: 'Hanuman Ansh' box office collection day 55: Vishal Chaturvedi film collects Rs 2.35 cr

author: SHIVANGHI PAYAL
description: Despite slight changes in oil prices today, Brent and WTI Crude both experienced gains in their last trading sessions. Investors remain alert to the evolving US-Iran negotiations, as their outcomes are likely to sway market dynamics. Furthermore, Saudi Arabia has restarted oil tanker loading activities via its East-West Pipeline. Recent statistics presented a mixed bag regarding US crude inventory levels, influencing market attitudes.
title: Oil prices stay flat as markets weigh US-Iran talks and Middle East supply

author: TOI SCIENCE DESK
description: Up to 1,000 African savanna elephants move through Tanzania’s Udzungwa Mountains and surrounding habitats, with some climbing slopes above 6,500 feet. A newly protected 14-kilometre wildlife corridor across the Kilombero Valley reconnects their historic range. Camera traps recorded 529 elephants among 1,440 mammals using the corridor during 15 months of monitoring.
title: Late NY mom's fundraiser wipes out $120M in medical debt

description: Jeff Bezos has made waves in the real estate market with a $200 million deposit for a stunning penthouse in Aman Beverly Hills. This expansive 31,000 square foot residence boasts lavish features like a rooftop swimming pool and private cinema, all designed by acclaimed Kerry Hill Architects. If finalized, it could smash records for condo sales in Los Angeles by 2028, adding to Bezos's impressive portfolio.

author: TOI ENTERTAINMENT DESK
description: Facing a downturn, 'The Paradise' recorded Rs 3.40 crore net in India on its seventh day. The Indian total now stands at Rs 104.90 crore, while the global gross reaches Rs 154.80 crore. The Telugu edition was responsible for Rs 2.65 crore of Day 7's revenue, primarily driven by Andhra Pradesh and Telangana, which provided Rs 2.85 crore.
title: 'The Paradise' BO day 7: Nani's actioner sees 22.7% drop; net reaches Rs 104.90 cr

author: SOROR SHAIZA
description: Cristiano Ronaldo has left Portugal’s camp ahead of Thursday’s Nations League clash with Denmark following a dispute over his role under new head coach Jorge Jesus. Ronaldo confirmed his departure after Jesus said he would not start the match. The 41-year-old has not announced his international retirement, but said he would reveal the reasons for his decision “in due time.”
title: Ronaldo leaves Portugal camp, promises truth 'in due time', wishes team-mates luck

author: TOI LIFESTYLE DESK
description: Many Indian homes use flowers in pooja, creating floral waste after the rituals are completed. Instead of discarding used flowers, they can be transformed into dhoop at home. The process involves drying, grinding, and mixing flowers with natural binders and essential oils. After shaping the mixture into cones, they must be dried again thoroughly.
title: Turn used pooja flowers into fragrant dhoop at home

author: VINEET RAMAKRISHNAN
description: Harita Bhadra arrived at the Asian Games chasing a podium finish and left Nagoya with two bronze medals, in the women’s 200m and mixed 4x100m relay. Her first senior international competition has also sharpened the next target: a 22.45-second run, the qualifying mark for the 2027 World Championships. Bhadra reflects on the races, the mental lessons from Nagoya, her relay experience and why she believes the next level is within reach.
title: After two Asian Games medals, Harita Bhadra sets her sights on 22.45s and World Championships

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: Arizona State University withdrew its eminent domain lawsuit against the historic Louis Emerson House to preserve the property. The decision followed widespread public opposition and a successful campaign led by John Young and Barry Schwartz. They generated substantial support through a petition that collected over 12,000 signatures. The university had filed the lawsuit seeking to acquire the property for a medical campus.
title: Man who owned historic home 51 years keeps it after ASU drops takeover bid

author: VIJAYA SRIVASTAVA
description: South Korea is making waves with a monumental commitment of $200 billion toward US energy endeavors. This ambitious plan encompasses a critical liquefied natural gas project in Alaska and a gas-fired power facility in Texas. Moreover, investments in eight nuclear reactors across the nation are also underway. These strategic ventures stem from a $350 billion trade agreement signed in November 2025, reinforcing economic cooperation between South Korea and the US.
title: Trump announces $200bn South Korean investment in US, $54bn for Alaska LNG

author: TNN
description: The Karnataka government is considering increasing fines for traffic violations, particularly for habitual offenders. This proposal includes escalating penalties and accumulating negative points for repeat violations. Additionally, the government plans to ban half-helmets to enhance safety for two-wheeler riders. Measures for regulating low-speed electric two-wheelers and promoting carpooling are also under discussion. Efforts are being made to improve public transport facilities and enforce traffic rules more strictly.
title: Drive wrong, pay more: Karnataka mulls Rs 5,000 fine for repeat traffic offenders
